name: Web Linguist – AI-Powered Website Translation & Multilingual SEO
author: growthdynamics

sections.description:
Unlock Global Reach with 1 Click – AI-Powered Website Translation for WordPress.

Web Linguist makes your WordPress site multilingual in minutes — using a powerful, context-aware AI translation engine. Translate your entire site instantly into any of 120+ languages, with SEO-friendly URLs, editable translations, and a customizable language switcher.

Unlike tools that rely on basic machine translation or JavaScript overlays, Web Linguist can create pre-rendered, indexable pages that actually rank in search engines — using real folders (like /es/ or /fr/) and proper hreflang tags.

Key Features

  • Translate your site into 120+ languages
  • AI-powered, context-aware translation engine
  • Customizable front-end language switcher
  • Real-time sync with site changes
  • Compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi & more
  • No code required
  • GDPR-friendly and privacy-conscious
  • Works with WooCommerce, blogs, and business sites

What Makes Web Linguist Different?

  • Superior AI Translations: Our LLM-powered model delivers natural, brand-consistent results — far beyond what other competitors can offer.
  • Real Multilingual SEO: Every translated page is crawlable, indexable, and geo-tagged — helping your site rank globally.
  • No Code, No Limitations: Most free tools inject text with JavaScript — we create real, static pages that Google can read.
  • Built for Agencies & Business Growth: Whether you’re a solo site owner or building for clients, Web Linguist unlocks real revenue and reach.

A Plan for Everyone

We believe everyone deserves a global voice. That’s why we offer a powerful free version with robust features.

Your free account includes:

  • 1 language (choose from 120+)
  • Full-site AI translation
  • Customizable language switcher
  • Meta data translation
  • Context-aware, brand-friendly output
  • Automatic sync when your content changes
  • Works with WordPress themes and builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, etc.)

No code. No devs. Just install, pick a language, and go live globally — for free. When you’re ready to scale, our paid plans unlock even more advanced capabilities, including larger translation volumes and premium support.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin is a client for the WebLinguist.ai Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform and relies on external services to function. Your use of the plugin is subject to the terms of these services.

1. WebLinguist.ai

  • Service Purpose: WebLinguist.ai is the core service that provides AI translation, user account management, license validation, and hosts the dashboard application you interact with in the WordPress admin area. The language switcher toolbar script is also delivered from our Content Delivery Network (CDN).
  • Data Sent & Conditions: When you register or log in through the plugin’s dashboard, your credentials are sent to our authentication service. Your site’s license key and an encrypted user authentication token are stored in your WordPress database to keep the service connected.
  • Service Links:
    • License Agreement: https://weblinguist.ai/license/
    • Privacy Policy: https://weblinguist.ai/privacy/

GPL Compliance & Source Code

In accordance with GPL guidelines, the source code for the dashboard application that runs within the WordPress admin area is publicly available under an MIT license. You can view, study, and modify the source code at our public GitHub repository: https://github.com/VentureForgeDevelopment/embedded-dashboard/

2. Stripe

  • Service Purpose: Stripe is our third-party payment processor, used to securely handle payments and subscriptions for WebLinguist’s premium plans.
  • Data Sent & Conditions: If you choose to upgrade to a paid plan, you will enter your payment information (such as name, email, and credit card details) directly into a secure form hosted by Stripe. This information is sent from your browser directly to Stripe; our servers do not store your sensitive credit card details.
  • Service Links:
    • Stripe Services Agreement: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa
    • Stripe Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Web Linguist plugin.
  2. Click “Web Linguist” in your WordPress admin menu.
  3. Create your free account or sign in.
  4. Select your site’s original language and choose your first target language.
  5. Customize your language switcher.
  6. You’re live globally!
sections.faq:
Q: Is it really free?

A: Yes — you can translate your full site into 1 language with no page limits. You choose the language.

Q: How does it compare to Google Translate?

A: Google Translate is a great tool — but it doesn’t give you SEO-friendly pages, edit control, or quality AI output. Web Linguist gives you all that and more.

Q: Will this affect my SEO?

A: In the best way possible. Web Linguist can create properly structured folders with hreflang and metadata — so search engines index your translated content.

Q: Can I customize the switcher?

A: Yes — you can choose style and placement.

Q: Do I need to know code?

A: Nope. It’s 100% no-code. Install, sign in, choose a language, and go live.
